description.value:
You always have the Counterspell spell prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can have prepared.

Additionally, whenever a creature fails the Saving Throw against a Counterspell you cast, you regain 1d4 Sorcery Points.

Automated: the Fimblewood Academy module grants you Counterspell as an always-prepared spell. When a target fails its save against your Counterspell, the module automatically rolls 1d4 and adds the result to your Sorcery Points (requires Midi QoL to detect the failed save automatically).

source.custom: Fimblewood Academy homebrew, adapted from "Unblooded Sorcery" (2026).
